title: Support detached and internally detached XAdES cosigning
blocker: The supported cosigning implementation needs the reference identifiers and digest transform used by a detached portal signature.
unblock: Provide a sanitized detached or internally detached XAdES file and original data accepted by AutoFirma.
notes: The signer requires a verified reference profile for detached and internally detached cosignatures.
done_when: A sanitized AutoFirma reference signature and matching data verify both original and new signatures after cosigning.
